name: Kugen
subtitle: Dad approved
notes: Typically eaten for General Conference as a side to a large slice of butter.

steps.title: Mix the batter
steps.body: Mix: **¾ cup sugar**, **2 Tbsp shortening** (not softened), **1 egg**, **1 cup milk**, **1 tsp vanilla**, **½ cup raisins** (optional), **2 cups flour**, **4 tsp baking powder**, **½ tsp salt**, **1 tsp cinnamon**, **¼ tsp nutmeg** and **½ cup nuts** (optional).

steps.title: Cut in the topping
steps.body: Cut together with pastry cutter: **¼ cup flour**, **¼ cup sugar**, **¼ cup brown sugar**, **¼ cup softened butter** (not melted), **½ tsp cinnamon**, dash nutmeg and optional nuts.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake for 30–40 minutes at 350°F, or until a toothpick comes out of the center clean.
